channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tobias Harris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tobias Harris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mitch Johnson on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Spurs coachMitch Johnson on Tobias Harris’ calf strain:

“It’s a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is. We won’t rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all.”

Mitch Johnson on Tobias Harris, Oct 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Anthony Tolliver on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Anthony Tolliver:

“I played with Tobias multiple years, bro. Like he's one of the best humans on the planet. He's a pro. But he is the pro's pro. He's like, I thought I was professional, bro. Like this dude literally everything he puts into his body, like every bite of everything, he's paying attention to it.”

Anthony Tolliver on Tobias Harris, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Jalen Duren:

“One person that up top of my head would be Tobias Harris. He was with us. He was a guy who took on a role of being the older guy and giving back, whether it be on the court or off the court information. He's willing to educate guys, so he was a guy who, and he wasn't the only one, but he was just the most recent that I can think of that really kind of poured into everybody.”

Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris, Sep 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Trajan Langdon on Tobias Harris:

“His approach and professionalism has been huge in terms of us establishing the environment we have in the past two years… They call him Unc for a reason… We hope that we can bring him back. He’s somebody we want to keep in a Pistons uniform.”

Trajan Langdon on Tobias Harris, May 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Detroit Pistons coach JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris:

“Nobody can say shit to me about Tobias Harris. He is dependable, reliable, prepared for the moment. He’s a leader. He’s a great teammate. He’s a great human being. He’s a high-level competitor.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris, May 3, 2026. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley
item.description:
“We needed that bad, being a young team, we just needed consistent vets, and they don’t only perform on the court but off the court.“Tobias is one guy who’s constantly teaching about all different things — life, financial stuff. Timmy, Malik (Beasley), they’ve very vocal. They’re not guys who are to themselves. They’re part of the group, they’re bringing guys up, they’re constantly competing. They’ve been huge for us.”

Jalen Duren on Tobias Harris, Malik Beasley, Mar 5, 2025. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on the missed free throw with a second remaining:

“Obviously that's tough, but we trust Tobias to knock his free throws down. He just missed it tonight.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris, Nov 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Omari Sankofa II:JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris’ lack of shot attempts:

“We have to get him more involved… he’s being extra unselfish. But we have to make sure we involve him more.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris, Oct 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris
item.description:
JB Bickerstaff:

“Tobias was the perfect piece for us and where we are. To be able to get him right out of the gate in free agency was huge for us. Again, I give Trajan a ton of credit for being able to get that done. Tobias is a really good human being. When you're going through some of the things that young teams go through, the character of the people who are going to be using their voice matters.”

JB Bickerstaff on Tobias Harris, Aug 7, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Nick Nurse on Tobias Harris not playing down the stretch:

“Just was going with what I thought we needed at the moment. I thought Tobias had played his guts out for the entire game. He was just on ‘E’ a little bit.”

Nick Nurse on Tobias Harris, Apr 18, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Paul Reed on Tobias Harris
item.description:
He and Reed have a great relationship and it’s due to the work the two put in together over the summer.

“I’ve been Tobias’s teammate for years now and I know what he’s capable of out there on the court and for me, it’s like I’m impressed, but I’m not really impressed,”

Paul Reed on Tobias Harris, Jan 13, 2024. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Torrel Harris on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Torrel Harris:

“Personally, I don’t think so. The reason I say that, well Tobias is an assassin scorer. I mean they can’t stop him. Nobody in the league can stop him. So he’s proven that over his career even when he was with the Clippers he was an assassin scorer.”

Torrel Harris on Tobias Harris, Jun 24, 2023. Source: LibertyBallers.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Lauren Rosen:Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris’ continued growth as a multidimensional shooting threat:

“He’s not just a catch-and-shoot, he’s a catch-and-rise guy…I’m really proud of the work that he’s put in.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Dec 16, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris (@Tobias Harris) today:

“Today was his best practice. Mentally, he’s completely given himself. He got open shots all day today, he’s been really good.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Oct 1, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Dave Joerger on James Harden, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Before you even get to the [roster] changes, I think you get to the fact that James Harden, Joel Embiid, and other guys did not have a lot of time together. Our core has had two years together – Tyrese [Maxey], Tobias [Harris] – and Joel and Tobias have been together for a number of years, we get that. But to add a guy who has the ball as much as James does, especially with Joel, that’s only going to get better as more time is spent together.”

Dave Joerger on James Harden, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 10, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: James Harden on Tobias Harris, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Daryl Morey, talking about James Harden:

“A full offseason, a full training camp, a full time where everyone can learn to unlock how good everyone can be together... That group -- Joel, James, Tobias, Maxey -- that group played very well together. We can play even better.”

James Harden on Tobias Harris, Tyrese Maxey, May 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @DerekBodnerNBA.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Lauren Rosen:Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris’ playoffs thus far:

“He’s been probably the most consistent player - as far as playing the right way, doing the right stuff. He’s been fantastic. I guess you could say he’s in a great mental space. He’s been great. He’s just playing.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @NickDePaula.

item.title: James Harden on Tobias Harris, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
James Harden on playing w/ Tobias Harris (@Tobias Harris) and the @Philadelphia 76ers:

“Tobias has that smooth game. He can shoot it, he can post up, he can score from anywhere. I think everybody on the floor - Tisse, to Danny, to Maxey - the entire group, they’re competitors. They want to win.”

James Harden on Tobias Harris, Tyrese Maxey, Feb 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Doc Rivers on Tyrese Maxey’s mentors, Joel Embiid and Tobias Harris:

“[Joel and Tobias are] a pretty good influence. Both lead by example. I think they’re both doing that… Joel’s been phenomenal… Tobias - we jokingly call him the machine.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, Oct 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Matisse Thybulle, Ben Simmons
item.description:
#Sixers coachDoc Rivers on if Ben Simmons addressed the team:

“We just introduced like we always do when a new guy comes back or the old guys comes back. We jokingly did it. We did it with Tobias as well, because he's been on vacation and Matisse as well. But as I told you before, the players pretty much welcome guys back.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Matisse Thybulle, Ben Simmons, Oct 17, 2021. Source: Twitter @PompeyOnSixers.

item.title: Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“It's been a long drought in Philadelphia, our fans are eagerly awaiting for the team to get over the top. There's a lot of controversy with the Ben Simmons situation, but it seems like the team is staying pat with their big three of Joel [Embiid], Ben [Simmons] and Tobias [Harris].I think if they add pieces, get another year in with Doc Rivers, because you know last year was his first year on the job with the Sixers. Sometimes you need time with people to really know how to bring out the best in them.”

Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Aug 27, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Rich Hoffman:Doc Rivers:

“We typically like one guy like Tobias or Ben with that [bench] group. We just played them deep in the first quarter.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Jun 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @rich_hofmann.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Scott Brooks on Tobias Harris:

“He’s an All-Star player. I don’t know why he hasn’t been one.”

Scott Brooks on Tobias Harris, May 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Davis Bertans on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Fred Katz:Davis Bertans on Tobias Harris’ 37-point performance:

“They got so many great players on that team that it’s hard. We put all of our attention on Tobias Harris, then Embiid is gonna go off. And it’s the same with Embiid.”

Davis Bertans on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, May 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Matisse Thybulle, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Well, I don’t have all of them because they’re hard to get. But I’ve got Joel (Embiid), I’ve got Ben (Simmons), I’ve got Tobias (Harris), I’ve got (Tyrese) Maxey, I’ve got (Matisse) Thybulle. “Some of the players need to complain and say, ‘Where are my highlights?’”

Daryl Morey on Tobias Harris, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Matisse Thybulle, Tyrese Maxey, Mar 13, 2021. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Rivers:

“Tobias is so darn skilled going right or left and we have to take advantage of that”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart
item.description:
Redick:

“In my little circle of T.J. McConnell, Doug McDermott, Tobias Harris and Josh Hart, it was usually me. But Josh has got some great Bordeaux in his collection. But he also had some shipped in. The last night I was there, I didn’t have enough room in my luggage to transport all of the wine back home to New York. So I brought six or seven bottles to the Grand Floridian hotel. I had a little wine meal with Timothé Luwawu-Cabarrot, Russell Westbrook, Doug, TJ and myself. Then (former Pelicans coach) Alvin Gentry and (Orlando Magic general manager) John Hammond happened to be sitting at the table next to us. So I shared a couple of sips with them.”

JJ Redick on John Hammond, Russell Westbrook, Alvin Gentry, Tobias Harris, Doug McDermott, TJ McConnell, Timothe Luwawu, Josh Hart, Sep 21, 2020. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Elton Brand on Tobias Harris
item.description:
76ers General Manager Elton Brand said.

“Tobias is one of the best three-point shooters in the NBA and possesses an innate ability to impact the game on both ends of the floor,while Boban and Mike provide valuable skillsets, size and depth to our team. All three players bring high character to our locker room and we are excited about their fit alongside Joel, Ben, Jimmy and our entire roster.”

Elton Brand on Tobias Harris, Feb 6, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris
item.description:
Royce Young:Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris:

“He’s better than I thought... we knew he was good, but didn’t know he was this good.”

Doc Rivers on Tobias Harris, Mar 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.
